watchdog_each_research_turn.start: Name one original goal node, physical quantity, scenario, comparison coordinate and discriminator.
watchdog_each_research_turn.finish: Record numeric change or counterexample, baseline, numerical error and next missing input. If only a plot or infrastructure changed, award zero science-node credit. Where clock effects dominate, report matched-time control.
watchdog_each_research_turn.redirect: If a repeated audit changes neither the physics nor its error bound, use the inherited gate and execute the next physical control.
